data.name: PaletteEmpty

data.name: AiAssistant_AgentNeedsWorkspace
data.value: O modo Agente precisa de um workspace carregado — selecione a pasta extraída na Home primeiro.

data.name: AiAssistant_AgentNeedsOutput

data.name: AiAssistant_ApplyCancelled

data.name: AiAssistant_SessionFailed

data.name: AiAssistant_SessionNotConnected

data.name: AiAssistant_Splitter

data.name: DashboardHeroSubtitleEmpty
data.value: Selecione uma pasta com os arquivos de dados do FFX (VBF extraído / ISO PS2) para habilitar todas as funções de edição. O workspace será validado ao carregar.

data.name: DashboardHeroSubtitleLoaded
data.value: Seu ambiente de modding FFX está carregado. Use a grade abaixo para ir a qualquer módulo, ou clique no rail de navegação à esquerda.

data.name: DashboardDragDropHint
data.value: ou arraste uma pasta para esta janela

data.name: Mod_home_Scope
data.value: Green domains: Kernel and Monsters. Blue domains: Battle, String, Macro, Event, and Extras read-only hubs. Yellow domains: Encounter routing, AI write paths, Event recompilation, Maps, and companion-file decoders.

data.name: Mod_home_Description
data.value: This shell is the staging ground for FFX kernel authoring, battle exploration, string and macro inspection, monster editing, future encounter and AI research, plus read-only Extras surfaces for PS2/PS3 knowledge.

data.name: Mod_home_Notes
data.value: Start with Commands, Items, Monster Commands 1/2, Monster Editor, Battle Explorer, String Explorer, Macro Explorer, Event Explorer, and the new Extras read-only shell. Those are the strongest surfaces already proven by the current stack.

data.name: Mod_monster_editor_Scope
data.value: Primary write path for monster data.

data.name: Mod_monster_editor_Description
data.value: Browse and edit the FFX monster species files with strong control over stats, loot, resistances, and structural data.

data.name: Mod_monster_editor_Notes
data.value: Backed by the current FFXProjectEditor monster file flow. Best candidate for heavy authoring work.

data.name: Mod_battle_commands_hub_Scope
data.value: Writers: command.bin (comandos de personagem), monmagic1.bin e monmagic2.bin (comandos exclusivos de monstro).

data.name: Mod_battle_commands_hub_Description
data.value: Comandos/magias de personagem e os dois bancos de comandos de monstro — uma só superfície, três sub-abas.

data.name: Mod_battle_commands_hub_Notes
data.value: Cada sub-aba edita uma tabela de comando do kernel (command.bin / monmagic1.bin / monmagic2.bin) via o mesmo editor de sempre. A pílula de modo da sub-aba ativa é o sinal autoritativo.

data.name: Mod_items_hub_Scope
data.value: Writers: item.bin, takara.bin, shop slot payload, prepare.bin. Key Items e Gear Rewards são read-only/guard hoje.

data.name: Mod_items_hub_Description
data.value: Itens, key items, baús/tesouros, recompensas de equipamento, lojas e a Mix Table — tudo numa superfície.

data.name: Mod_items_hub_Notes
data.value: Items=item.bin · Key Items=important.bin (guard) · Treasures=takara.bin · Gear Rewards=buki_get.bin (read-only) · Shop=slot payload guardado · Mix Table=prepare.bin. A pílula da sub-aba ativa é o sinal autoritativo.

data.name: Mod_customizations_hub_Description
data.value: Customization de equipamento, aeon grow/teach e auto-abilities — uma superfície, duas sub-abas.

data.name: Mod_customizations_hub_Notes
data.value: Customization / Aeons = writer de kaizou.bin + sum_grow.bin (com abas internas Gear / Aeon Grow); Auto-Abilities = writer de a_ability.bin + arms_rate.bin atrás de um self-check RT0. A pílula da sub-aba ativa é o sinal autoritativo.

data.name: Mod_stats_hub_Description
data.value: Stats/growth dos personagens e a tabela CTB de timing de batalha — uma superfície, duas sub-abas.

data.name: Mod_stats_hub_Notes
data.value: PC Stats / Growth = writer de ply_save.bin + ply_rom.bin (stats base + curva de growth); CTB Base = btl.bin (timing de batalha) — uma superfície, cinco sub-abas.

data.name: Mod_enemy_design_hub_Scope
data.value: Writers: scripts de IA em monster_*.bin, clones de m###.bin (novo slot), e escala em massa de m###.bin.

data.name: Mod_enemy_design_hub_Description
data.value: AI de monstro, criação de boss custom e o director de dificuldade — uma superfície, três sub-abas.

data.name: Mod_enemy_design_hub_Notes
data.value: Monster AI Editor = editor de comportamento e DevKit tecnico do script ATEL; Custom Boss Creator = clona um m###.bin pra um novo slot (stats/nome/ModelId); Difficulty Director = escala stats em todos os m###.bin. A pilula de modo da sub-aba ativa e o sinal autoritativo.

data.name: Mod_sphere_grid_hub_Scope
data.value: Explorer + Panel pedem projeto; Builder/Canvas abrem sem projeto (gravar no projeto precisa de projeto).

data.name: Mod_sphere_grid_hub_Description
data.value: Explorer, Panel, Builder e Canvas — uma superfície, quatro sub-abas.

data.name: Mod_sphere_grid_hub_Notes
data.value: Explorer = sphere/panel/abmap + layout content; Panel = panel.bin grow/restore/edit; Builder/Canvas = topologia byte-safe offline (in-game não provado).

data.name: Mod_text_hub_Scope
data.value: Writers: w_name.bin, btl_txt.bin. String/Macro/Event seguem read-only.

data.name: Mod_text_hub_Description
data.value: String, macro, weapon names, battle text e event — uma superfície, cinco sub-abas.

data.name: Mod_text_hub_Notes
data.value: String/Macro/Event = exploradores read-only; Weapon Names (w_name.bin) e Battle Text (btl_txt.bin) = writers de texto seguros (RT0 provado). A pílula da sub-aba ativa é o sinal autoritativo.

data.name: Mod_blitzball_Scope
data.value: Writers edit bltz0002.ebp (roster stat-growth), the recruitment .ebp scripts, takara.bin (prize pool) and bltz0200.ebp (prize table + odds). The Atlas tab is read-only with no game-file writes.

data.name: Mod_blitzball_Description
data.value: Roster, recruits, prize pool, prize table and the read-only prize Atlas — one surface, five sub-tabs.

data.name: Mod_blitzball_Notes
data.value: Four writer-lab editors (game-file edits, RT0 byte-identity proven / in-game RT2 pending) plus a read-only Spira Data Atlas catalog. The active sub-tab's mode pill is the authoritative read-only vs writer signal.

data.name: Mod_save_editor_Scope
data.value: Writer: Character stats (18 slots). PSU + raw PS2 + PC .ffx supported. RT0: --ffx-save-rt0 on 25848-byte files.

data.name: Mod_save_editor_Description
data.value: Edit FFX playthrough save files (.psu, raw 25848-byte blobs, PC .ffx). Native port of FFXED v0.749 — Character tab first; other sections via FFXED.jar launcher until ported.

data.name: Mod_save_editor_Notes
data.value: Independent from the kernel workspace: point at a real save on disk. Checksum + tamper tag recalculated on save (dagal/FFXED algorithm). Equipment/Items/Blitzball/Sphere Grid/Minigame/Misc still route to bundled FFXED.jar.

data.name: Mod_encounters_hub_Scope
data.value: Writer: os 8 slots de monstro do btl_* (Formation Editor). Encounter Table segue read-only (sem save de tabela exposto).

data.name: Mod_encounters_hub_Description
data.value: Roteamento de encontros (btl.bin) e a formação de 8 monstros de cada btl_* — o par natural, numa superfície, duas sub-abas.

data.name: Mod_encounters_hub_Notes
data.value: Encounter Table = leitura read-only da tabela de roteamento (mapa→grupo→battle id; double-click abre o Aurora Chamber).

data.name: Mod_aurora_chamber_Scope
data.value: Edição offline do projeto e prévia de cenário. O salvamento preserva Y/W e os demais bytes da batalha. Este visualizador não executa a IA completa nem substitui a validação no jogo.

data.name: Mod_aurora_chamber_Description
data.value: Une a BIANCA (catalogo das 25 cenas btlmap) ao MapViewer: escolha uma cena -> renderize a geometria HD -> pegue as coordenadas dos atores (chunk3). Para a Aurora e a Bianca.

data.name: Mod_aurora_chamber_Notes
data.value: O NoClip exibe a batalha selecionada e salva X/Z dos monstros no projeto com backup. A edição avançada permanece no MapViewer. Sem escrita no processo do jogo; SPIRA FORGE continua pausado.

data.name: Mod_aurora_field_explorer_Scope
data.value: Field picker + render offline com ps3data; encounter list exige master/ (btl.bin). Nenhum writer.

data.name: Mod_aurora_field_explorer_Description
data.value: Explore mapas overworld (map/) no MapViewer e veja encontros roteados pelo btl.bin para aquele field — modulo separado da Aurora Chamber (arenas btlmap).

data.name: Mod_aurora_field_explorer_Notes
data.value: Fase 1: picker de ~299 fields HD, export Phyre on-demand, painel btl.bin (grupos/danger/battleId) + overlay MapViewer. Demarcacao espacial de zonas de encontro no chao = RE pendente (mapout.vpa).

data.name: Mod_map_scene_editor_Scope
data.value: Lab editável (sidecar, sem reserializar o glTF). Round-trip durável pro JOGO segue fronteira (só textura tem writer byte-exato provado). 'Open in Browser' = fallback.

data.name: Mod_map_scene_editor_Description
data.value: Edite a cena do Map Viewer embarcado dentro do editor via WebView2: selecione uma submalha, mova-a com o gizmo, ajuste materiais e luzes e salve as edições no sidecar local map-edits.json.

data.name: Mod_map_scene_editor_Notes
data.value: O StudioWebServer privado do aplicativo hospeda o viewer embarcado em uma porta loopback escolhida pelo sistema. Não exige Python, checkout do repositório, aba de navegador ou CDN.

data.name: Mod_battle_explorer_Scope
data.value: Read-heavy today. Formation editing comes next; full encounter routing and ATEL authoring stay controlled.

data.name: Mod_battle_explorer_Description
data.value: Inspect battle files as real multi-chunk assets: ATEL script, worker mapping, formation, positions, and encounter-table footprint.

data.name: Mod_battle_explorer_Notes
data.value: This is the first serious read-heavy bridge into encounter work. Safe focus: inspect structures, confirm references, and prepare the future formation editor.

data.name: Mod_runtime_dll_manager_Scope
data.value: Controls game-root proxy DLLs and modules\\*.dll. Runtime proof comes from process modules plus FFXProbeBlock_v1 / FFXHooksBlock_v1 where available.

data.name: Mod_runtime_dll_manager_Description
data.value: Show which runtime DLLs are installed, disabled, or currently visible in FFX, then stage on/off changes for the next game boot.

data.name: Mod_runtime_dll_manager_Notes
data.value: Jarvis is keeping this honest: file toggles arm the loader by renaming/copying DLLs; already loaded code stays alive until FFX restarts.

data.name: Mod_live_battle_lab_Scope
data.value: Read-heavy plus proven runtime writes. Good for rapid test loops against Commands, Items, MonMagic, Auto-Abilities, Customizations, and Aeon Grow.

data.name: Mod_live_battle_lab_Description
data.value: Inspect the live BTL runtime, reload proven file domains straight into memory, and prepare force-battle work without guessing at ATEL or routing writes.

data.name: Mod_live_battle_lab_Notes
data.value: Jarvis is only exposing the pieces already proven by this codebase: battle-state inspection, enemy runtime snapshots, in-memory reload of known buffers, and BTL debug flags. Force Battle stays experimental until its trigger path is genuinely trusted.

data.name: Mod_aurora_overlay_lab_Scope
data.value: Writes only module-loader config files under the game modules folder. The running DLL reads these on startup; restart the game after changing the config.

data.name: Mod_aurora_overlay_lab_Description
data.value: Configure the ffx-hooks.dll Aurora W2S/texture overlay from the editor, writing persistent modules\\config flags and aurora_overlay.ini for the next game boot.

data.name: Mod_aurora_overlay_lab_Notes
data.value: This productizes the proved W2S/D3D11 overlay as an operable switchboard. It does not rename the native renderer or promote the IDA owner candidates beyond their current evidence.

data.name: Mod_battle_tracker_Description
data.value: Inspect live battle-state data while the game is running and compare runtime values against file-authored expectations.

data.name: Mod_battle_tracker_Notes
data.value: Best used as telemetry and verification, not as the foundation of the authoring pipeline.

data.name: Mod_inventory_tracker_Description
data.value: Inspect runtime inventory state and quickly validate item-table effects or progression-related test cases.

data.name: Mod_inventory_tracker_Notes
data.value: Good for debug loops and validating kernel-side edits.

data.name: Mod_arena_tracker_Description
data.value: Track monster arena progress and runtime state during real gameplay sessions for research and verification.

data.name: Mod_arena_tracker_Notes
data.value: Useful as an operational panel while authoring monster and encounter changes elsewhere.

data.name: Mod_debug_menu_Scope
data.value: Live-game helper. Not the canonical save path.

data.name: Mod_debug_menu_Description
data.value: Live runtime toggles and save-adjacent debugging helpers for rapid inspection work against the running game.

data.name: Mod_debug_menu_Notes
data.value: Useful for fast experiments, but runtime editing should not replace file-authored workflows.

data.name: Mod_textures_tm2_Scope
data.value: Read-only only. Native preview is limited to the proved indexed TIM2 cohort; experimental, metadata-only, and blocked states stay explicit.

data.name: Mod_textures_tm2_Description
data.value: Inspect the first honest visual Extras lane: TIM2 inventory, provenance, preview state, and read-only preview for compatible indexed cohorts.

data.name: Mod_textures_tm2_Notes
data.value: Jarvis is starting with the Pt56 quick win on purpose. This surface is for preview, metadata, and guardrails, not for pretending the whole texture family is solved.

data.name: Mod_bin_ftc_atlas_Scope
data.value: Read-only only. No parser-final claim, no writer, no repack, no semantic decoder promotion.

data.name: Mod_bin_ftc_atlas_Description
data.value: Inspect the PS2 master `.bin/.ftc` forest as buckets, sidecar pairs, FTC lanes, and sensitivity zones instead of pretending it is one solved format.

data.name: Mod_bin_ftc_atlas_Notes
data.value: Jarvis is only exposing the honest P0 lane here: overview, buckets, first64 dwords, FTC header lane, paired sidecars, and hard read-only warnings.

data.name: Mod_project_pipeline_Scope
data.value: Read-only only. PIPELINE / NOT FINAL ASSET / DO NOT WRITE stay explicit. This is for lineage, descriptors, and support carriers, not for patching or repacking.

data.name: Mod_project_pipeline_Description
data.value: Inspect proj, cdrom.*, eiichi_abmap_data, and ABMap lineage as build/index/pipeline surfaces instead of pretending those files are final runtime assets.

data.name: Mod_project_pipeline_Notes
data.value: Jarvis is exposing the honest Pt54 cut here: cdrom triplets, descriptor lanes, ABMap support inventory, graph edges, and hard provenance warnings.

data.name: Mod_magic_effects_Scope
data.value: Read-only only. No magic constructor, no writer, no color-override promotion, and no runtime-consumer proof claim.

data.name: Mod_magic_effects_Description
data.value: Inspect the battle/kernel lane, mag_* packages, bat_eff presentation lane, and the still-blocked causal bridge between them without pretending magic construction is solved.

data.name: Mod_magic_effects_Notes
data.value: This is the honest Pt67 cut: kernel-side, package-side, and presentation-side context in one place, with the blocked kernel -> mag_* -> bat_eff join kept explicit.

data.name: Mod_ps3_magic_Scope
data.value: Writable only in the narrow mip0/same-shape path. No mip-chain authoring, atlas reassembly, timeline/compiler, or model/animation playback claim.

data.name: Mod_ps3_magic_Description
data.value: Browse the HD remaster magic-effect textures (ps3data\\magic), preview decoded .dds.phyre surfaces, extract DDS, import same-shape DDS/raw mip0 and recolor cloned effects.

data.name: Mod_ps3_magic_Notes
data.value: Jarvis is surfacing the ps3data magic tree as honest texture authoring: mip0 decode/repack for ARGB8 / DXT1 / DXT3 / DXT5 / L8, with unknown classes kept metadata-only.

data.name: Mod_magic_dll_browser_Scope
data.value: Writes are explicit only: clone, byte-identical repack, patch plan, or external C/ASM rebuild. Automatic perfect C decompilation is not claimed.

data.name: Mod_magic_dll_browser_Description
data.value: Inspect and author the native magicFiles\\FFX magic_####.dll lane: PE sections, imports, exports, strings, overlay-table evidence, byte-preserving rebuild, patch plans, clone-to-ID, and generated C/ASM rebuild projects.

data.name: Mod_magic_dll_browser_Notes
data.value: Jarvis is exposing the missing runtime half of HD magic effects. The safe path is byte-preserving compile plus controlled byte/string/ASM patches; full C behavior requires manual native authoring over the generated harness.

data.name: Mod_phyre_package_io_Scope
data.value: This does not yet compile glTF/FBX/DAE source into .dae.phyre. Whole model compilation remains the Phyre mesh compiler frontier; this UI exposes the safe package I/O path directly.

data.name: Mod_phyre_package_io_Description
data.value: Import, extract and safely stage PhyreEngine packages used by FFX HD: .dds.phyre textures, .dae.phyre model packages, .ags.phyre animation carriers and .fx.phyre shader blobs.

data.name: Mod_phyre_package_io_Notes
data.value: DDS is native same-shape payload I/O: extract DDS and import DDS/raw mip0 into the existing container. DAE/AGS/FX are protected compiled-package imports: inspect, manifest, backup, and replace with an already-built .phyre package.

data.name: Mod_vbf_extract_Scope
data.value: No VBF repack path is exposed here. Repacking stays research/lab-only until separately proved and intentionally requested.

data.name: Mod_vbf_extract_Description
data.value: Extract the user's own FFX/FFX-2 HD VBF archives into a local source tree so the editor's PS2/PS3 asset browsers can work without a separate manual tool step.

data.name: Mod_vbf_extract_Notes
data.value: Jarvis is wrapping the local VBFExtract tool as a preparation step: read original archive, write extracted files, then keep runtime modding on loose files through the existing hook/external loader.

data.name: Mod_magic_viewer_web_Scope
data.value: Read-only. Catalogo gerado offline (MagicCorpusIndexer + opcional merge wave4); texture preview e secundario; efeito/timeline engine-accurate continua BLOCKED.

data.name: Mod_magic_viewer_web_Description
data.value: Leitor embarcado das magias FFXMagicViewerWeb: Runtime DLL Map primeiro, depois Package Graph, Texture Stack, Runtime Evidence e Crosswalk.

data.name: Mod_magic_viewer_web_Notes
data.value: Mesmo WebView2 dentro do editor, mas a pagina agora abre no mapa real de magicFiles\\FFX\\magic_####.dll; navegador e so fallback.

data.name: Mod_model_viewer_web_Scope
data.value: Read-only 3D gallery. Abre só no clique do usuário; sem referenciar campo XAML nomeado. Não há project gate — o catálogo é self-contained.

data.name: Mod_model_viewer_web_Description
data.value: Explore a galeria three.js embarcada com 816 modelos HD: filtre por categoria ou veredito e reproduza os clipes de animação glTF disponíveis.

data.name: Mod_model_viewer_web_Notes
data.value: O ViewerHub serve o código embarcado em /model/ e os assets locais escolhidos pelo usuário em /viewer-data/model/. Não exige checkout do repositório, servidor Python, CDN ou navegação file URI.

data.name: Mod_model_viewer_embedded_Scope
data.value: Read-only 3D gallery. Uses the installed Edge WebView2 runtime; if Python is unavailable the panel reports a clear bootstrap error.

data.name: Mod_model_viewer_embedded_Description
data.value: Renderize a galeria three.js de modelos HD dentro do editor com o host WebView2 privado do aplicativo.

data.name: Mod_model_viewer_embedded_Notes
data.value: O StudioWebServer usa uma porta loopback escolhida pelo sistema e raízes de dados privadas do aplicativo; o runtime WebView2 instalado renderiza o painel.

data.name: Mod_ps2_rsd_models_Scope
data.value: Read-only only. No 3D render (that stays the ModelViewer lane), no vertex/material editing, and no writer.

data.name: Mod_ps2_rsd_models_Description
data.value: Browse the PS2 RSD model bundles (MatEditor toolchain) from ffx_ps2: ASCII manifest @RSD940102 + @PLY940102 mesh counts + @MAT990928 material + .tm2 texture linkage.

data.name: Mod_ps2_rsd_models_Notes
data.value: Jarvis is surfacing the proved PS2 RSD bundle: PLY geometry counts (V/N/Poly), MAT material count, and TEX -> .tm2 resolution. Structural truth only.

data.name: Mod_ps2_audio_Scope
data.value: Read-only only. No writer/repack into .wd, no codec reimplementation, and no claim that the ~25 vgmstream-blocked variants are solved. WAV output goes only to a folder you pick.

data.name: Mod_ps2_audio_Description
data.value: Browse the PS2 .wd sound banks (Square WD header) from ffx_ps2: parse the proved descriptor layout (id / programs / samples + per-sample body offsets and ADSR), then decode PlayStation-ADPCM to WAV through the external vgmstream oracle.

data.name: Mod_ps2_audio_Notes
data.value: Jarvis is surfacing the proved PS2 WD bank: descriptor inventory validated at 843/843 no-edit byte identity, with optional vgmstream decode/export/play. No codec is reimplemented in-app.

data.name: Mod_presentation_containers_Scope
data.value: Read-only only. No map renderer, no event compiler, no timeline decoder, and no container writer.

data.name: Mod_presentation_containers_Description
data.value: Browse .vpa/.ebp/.omd/.sps2 cohorts as read-only container families with signature, companion, and cohort evidence before any deep decoder claims land.

data.name: Mod_presentation_containers_Notes
data.value: This is the honest Pt57 cut: strong cohorts, useful signatures, and cold structural navigation without pretending map/event/presentation semantics are fully solved.

data.name: Mod_battle_corpus_crosswalk_Scope
data.value: Read-only only. No owner/target/runtime claims, no formation writer, and no dispatch promotion.

data.name: Mod_battle_corpus_crosswalk_Title
data.value: Extras / Crosswalk do corpus de batalha

data.name: Mod_battle_corpus_crosswalk_Description
data.value: Crosswalk battleId -> formation slots 0..7 -> actor rows 0..10 -> rawMonsterId -> parser corpus overlay without promoting watchlist rows into composition truth.

data.name: Mod_battle_corpus_crosswalk_Notes
data.value: This is the honest Pt44 cut: battle composition, encounter references, and corpus overlay in one cold surface, with rows 8..10 kept as runtime watchlist only.

data.name: Mod_ps2_knowledge_Scope
data.value: Read-only only. Companion roots: master, ffx_ps2, ps3data. No decoder-final authority, no playback claims, no writer-safe promotion.

data.name: Mod_ps2_knowledge_Description
data.value: Expose the PS2 campaign as a read-only product shell: source roots, family registry, provenance, sensitivity, and shared Extras contracts before decoder or writer claims land.

data.name: Mod_ps2_knowledge_Notes
data.value: This is the first real Extras surface. Jarvis is keeping it family-first, provenance-heavy, and brutally honest about what is structural, blocked, or not ready for promotion.

data.name: Mod_albhed_dictionary_Description
data.value: Edit US Latin and JP kana glyph mappings in albheddic.bin with byte-safe undo/save.

data.name: Mod_albhed_dictionary_Notes
data.value: Safe scope: mapped glyph and group bucket on existing rows. Table shape and source bytes stay fixed.

data.name: Mod_pointer_script_table_Scope
data.value: Read-only. Resolve o arquivo do master configurado no projeto ou da referência extraída do jogo.

data.name: Mod_pointer_script_table_Description
data.value: Família Wave-1 com writer byte-safe (preserve-only) + gate RT0 provados, mas ainda sem tela dedicada — browser read-only.

data.name: Mod_pointer_script_table_Notes
data.value: Parqueada na categoria '???' até ganhar editor próprio. O writer existe (RT0 byte-identico no-edit), mas editar segue fora de escopo desta tela.

data.name: MainWinTagline
data.value: Kernel, monstros, encontros, strings e eventos.

data.name: MainWinThemeToggle
data.value: Alternar tema: Dark Studio / Alto Contraste WCAG

data.name: CommonSearchAbilityByHex
data.value: Pesquisar habilidade por nome ou hex

data.name: CommonFilterItems
data.value: Filtrar itens por nome, id ou tipo bruto

data.name: CommonEditSumGrow
data.value: Edita sum_grow.bin: como os aeons aprendem habilidades e quais boosts de status recebem.

data.name: CommonSumGrowShapes
data.value: sum_grow.bin mistura duas formas: receitas de ensino de habilidade e uma pequena cauda de boost de status. O Jarvis mantém esses modos separados e preserva o byte bruto de flag.

data.name: CommonFilterByCommand
data.value: Filtrar por comando, status, item ou índice

data.name: CommonEditKaizou
data.value: Edita receitas do kaizou.bin que adicionam auto-habilidades a armas e armaduras.

data.name: CommonKaizouExistingOnly
data.value: Esta tabela só edita entradas existentes do kaizou.bin. O Jarvis mantém o header fixo e a contagem de receitas intactos.

data.name: CommonKaizouVanilla
data.value: O kaizou.bin vanilla é pesado em habilidades. O modo stat continua suportado, mas o Jarvis não sintetiza novos tipos de entrada.

data.name: CommonSecondaryByte

data.name: U_weapon_bin_layout_notes_8a2c4e91
data.value: weapon.bin usa o mesmo layout que EquipmentStruct (22 bytes). Model_id é armazenado como dois bytes separados (0x0C-0x0D, little-endian). nameId=0x0000 sempre (catálogo usa w_name.bin). exists=0x01 sempre. equipped/save fields=0x0000 sempre (não aplicável em catálogo). 0x0000 em Model_id significa "resolvido via nome da arma em w_name.bin"; valores não-zero (Seymour 0x4066/0x4067, Yojimbo 0x3017) são overrides de modelo.
